exposure: placental blood perfusion using three-dimensional (3D) power Doppler ultrasonography (vascularization index (VI), flow index (FI), vascularization flow index (VFI))
cohort: The study included women with singleton pregnancies.
finding: Placental 3D power Doppler indices (VI and FI) were significantly higher in the third trimester in pregnancies developing macrosomia compared to those with a normal birth weight.
